page.notes: The right margin holds faint, very small marginal notes (several lines, roughly beside the entries from "Iurisconsultorum" to the end). They are too faint to read, so they are marked illegible and not guessed. The left margin is the binding and has no text. The "§.18." line at the top is a continuation of an entry from the previous page. Some italic/roman distinctions in the reference lines are approximate. The entry "veterum" is split across a line end without a printed hyphen. The final line is partly cut off at the right and is copied as far as legible.
